output:
Let me start by inspecting the workspace and docs.

The build now works. `python3 tools/stratum.py build` succeeds and all four checks pass. It produces `dist/labels.csv` (1400 rows) and `dist/taxa.json` (188 taxa).

An upgraded copy of the 1.6.0 database has the same schema as the fresh build. It also has the same rows in all four tables, including the converted elevations. I upgraded a copy under `/tmp`, not the file under `releases/`.

What I changed:
- **`migrations/0012_elevation_metres.sql`:** it now drops `idx_specimen_site_elev` before dropping `elevation_ft`, then recreates it on `(site_code, elevation_m)`. The old `CAST(... / 3.281)` truncated instead of rounding. It now does feet × 0.3048 in integer arithmetic, rounding halves away from zero.
- **`migrations/0013_taxon_full_name.sql`:** it no longer uses `concat_ws`, which SQLite 3.40.1 doesn't have. The generated `full_name` is built with `||` and `CASE`.
- **`views/v_specimen_label.sql`:** the elevation is now `<metres> m`, from `elevation_m`.
- **`stratum.toml`:**
  - `collectors.csv` is read as `cp1252`.
  - The taxon seed is `deferred`, so a child row can come before its parent.
  - The basis map gained `TS` and `SD`.

I did not touch migrations 0001–0011, `tools/stratum.py` or `seeds/`.

One limit: a newer collector export that contains a byte `cp1252` leaves undefined (0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90 or 0x9D) would fail to decode. The current file doesn't have any.

I deleted `build/` and `dist/` afterwards and wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md docs/schema.md docs/stratum.md
cd /app; sed -n 1,400p docs/BUILDING.md | tail -n +50; echo ======; cat docs/schema.md; echo =====; cat docs/stratum.md; cat stratum.toml CHANGELOG.md
cd /app; for f in migrations/*.sql views/*.sql checks/*.sql; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; for f in seeds/*; do echo "== $f"; head -5 $f; wc -l $f; file $f; done; python3 tools/stratum.py build

cd /app; python3 - <<'E'
import glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('seeds/*.csv')):
    b=open(f,'rb').read()
    try: b.decode('utf-8'); u='utf8 ok'
    except Exception as e: u=str(e)[:80]
    print(f,u,b[:3],b.count(b'\r\n'),b.count(b'\n'), sorted(set(x for x in b if x>=128 or x<32)))
E
cut -d, -f8 seeds/specimens.csv | sort | uniq -c; sed -n 1,30p tools/stratum.py | head -5; grep -n 'utf\|encoding\|newline' tools/stratum.py | head -30

cd /app; cat > migrations/0012_elevation_metres.sql <<'E'
-- 2.0: elevations in metres. Existing rows are converted from feet
-- (international foot, 0.3048 m), rounded to the nearest metre, halves away from zero.
-- The index on the feet column has to go before the column can be dropped.
DROP INDEX idx_specimen_site_elev;
ALTER TABLE specimen ADD COLUMN elevation_m INTEGER;
UPDATE specimen
SET elevation_m = CASE WHEN elevation_ft < 0
                       THEN -((-elevation_ft * 3048 + 5000) / 10000)
                       ELSE (elevation_ft * 3048 + 5000) / 10000 END
WHERE elevation_ft IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE specimen DROP COLUMN elevation_ft;
CREATE INDEX idx_specimen_site_elev ON specimen (site_code, elevation_m);
E
cat > migrations/0013_taxon_full_name.sql <<'E'
-- 2.0: the full scientific name of a taxon, computed from its parts.
ALTER TABLE taxon ADD COLUMN full_name TEXT
    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
        genus ||
        CASE WHEN epithet IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || epithet ELSE '' END ||
        CASE rank WHEN 'subspecies' THEN ' subsp. ' || infra
                  WHEN 'variety' THEN ' var. ' || infra
                  ELSE '' END
    ) VIRTUAL;
E
python3 - <<'E'
import re
p='stratum.toml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('file = "seeds/collectors.csv"\n','file = "seeds/collectors.csv"\nencoding = "cp1252"\n')
s=s.replace('file = "seeds/taxa.csv"\n','file = "seeds/taxa.csv"\ndeferred = true\n')
s=s.replace('LS = "living"\n','LS = "living"\nTS = "tissue"\nSD = "seed"\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
sed -i 's/s.elevation_ft || . ft. AS elevation/s.elevation_m || '"' m'"' AS elevation/' views/v_specimen_label.sql; grep elevation views/*.sql
rm -rf build dist; python3 tools/stratum.py build

cd /app; cp releases/1.6.0/herbarium.sqlite /tmp/up.sqlite; python3 tools/stratum.py upgrade /tmp/up.sqlite | tail -8; python3 - <<'E'
import sqlite3
a=sqlite3.connect('build/herbarium.sqlite'); b=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/up.sqlite')
q="select type,name,tbl_name,sql from sqlite_schema where name not like 'sqlite_%' order by 1,2"
ra,rb=a.execute(q).fetchall(),b.execute(q).fetchall()
print(len(ra),len(rb))
for x,y in zip(ra,rb):
    if x!=y: print('DIFF',x,y)
for t in ['site','collector','taxon','specimen']:
    cols=[r[1] for r in a.execute(f'pragma table_info({t})')]
    ca=a.execute(f'select * from {t} order by 1').fetchall(); cb=b.execute(f'select {",".join(cols)} from {t} order by 1').fetchall()
    print(t,len(ca),len(cb),ca==cb)
    if ca!=cb:
        n=0
        for x,y in zip(ca,cb):
            if x!=y and n<8: print(' ',x,y); n+=1
        print(set(ca)^set(cb) and len(set(ca)^set(cb)))
E

cd /app; python3 - <<'E'
import sqlite3

q='select * from taxon order by 1'

head -3 dist/labels.csv; head -8 dist/taxa.json; git status --short 2>&1 | head; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null

{"status": "success", "summary": "Fixed migration 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metre rounding) and 0013 (no concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 collectors, deferred taxa, TS/SD basis codes). A fresh build passes all checks, and an upgraded 1.6.0 copy has the same schema and rows."}
E
